Phase I: 00:00-00:04
Character Appearance: The character is clad in a black shinobi outfit with a glowing red sigil on the back; two katanas are secured to the waist, creating a sharp silhouette against the dim background.

Character Actions: The character executes a high-altitude dive, utilizing a grapple hook to seize a withered tree branch, performing a large-scale parabolic swing before landing gracefully on a cliff edge.

Scene Dynamics: The environment shifts from a deep, shadowy canyon abyss to a rocky plateau, with lighting transitioning from dim valley shadows to the warm afterglow of the cliff top.

Camera Movement: A third-person follow camera tracks the swing with sharp vertical tilting, quickly re-centering upon landing to align with the forward path.

Phase II: 00:04-00:11
Character Appearance: Maintaining a sprinting stance, the red VFX on the character's back becomes prominent against the dark cave entrance.

Character Actions: The character accelerates into a natural tunnel formed by rock crevices, maintaining a low center of gravity over uneven terrain, then drops down several rocky tiers to reach a snowy open area.

Scene Dynamics: A dramatic environmental transition occurs as dry, yellowish rock walls give way to the "Sunken Valley," characterized by cool blue mist and heavy snowfall.

Camera Movement: The camera pushes forward horizontally close to the character's back, elevating as they enter the clearing to reveal the colossal serpentine body in the distance.

Phase III: 00:11-00:16
Character Appearance: Standing at the precipice of a snowy cliff, the character merges with the swirling snowflakes and dense fog.

Character Actions: The character leaps from the cliff edge into a long-distance freefall, precision-aiming for the head of the massive Great Serpent moving below.

Scene Dynamics: The background is filled with rolling clouds and mist; the texture of the giant white scales becomes increasingly detailed as the character approaches, creating immense visual pressure.

Camera Movement: The camera locks onto the Great Serpent below, looking straight down along the character's dive trajectory to enhance the visceral sense of speed and impact.

Phase IV: 00:16-00:27
Character Appearance: The character is perched atop the serpent's head, with red prosthetic arm effects intermingling with massive splatters of red blood particles.

Character Actions: Initiating a deathblow, the character plunges a blade into the serpent's head, followed by a rhythmic second leap and re-stabbing motion, displaying fluid and lethal combat mechanics.

Scene Dynamics: The center of the frame is obscured by blood splatter; the canyon walls in the background move violently as the giant serpent writhes in agony.

Camera Movement: The camera enters a shaky close-up mode, synchronized with the rhythmic impacts of the execution, rotating slightly around the serpent's head to capture the intensity.

Phase V: 00:27-00:43
Character Appearance: With the execution complete, the character stands firmly on the now-stationary serpent carcass, as blood effects gradually dissipate.

Character Actions: The character sheathes their katana and remains standing to observe the battlefield before the screen fades to black, transitioning to a tutorial UI.

Scene Dynamics: The dynamic combat environment returns to stillness; snow continues to fall over the carcass of the beast, with distant pines appearing faintly through the mist.

Camera Movement: The camera slowly zooms out and stabilizes into a panoramic view, overlooking the character standing atop the serpent until the UI prompt appears and the scene fades.
